title: Forest River Debuts New Cedar Creek Cottage 40CMK Layout
summary: Explore the new 2026 Cedar Creek Cottage, a perfect camper for destination living with a stunning kitchen and seasonal comfort.
body_markdown:
With the official debut of the 2026 Cedar Creek Cottage 40CMK, Forest River has delivered an ideal camper for destination living. From a masterfully designed front kitchen to ultra-thick insulation and upgraded HVAC systems for extended-season comfort, this destination trailer is built for the long haul, whether you’re moving in full-time or searching for a seasonal home base you can easily relocate when needed.


## The Benefits of the Front Kitchen


Image by Forest River


The heart of the 40CMK is arguably the most impressive kitchen in the destination trailer market. Featuring a front-facing panoramic window, it offers a view that turns meal prep into an experience.


- **Residential Power:** Includes a full-size residential refrigerator, an oversized microwave and oven, and a three-burner cooktop with cast-iron grates.
- **Upgraded Cabinetry:** Dovetail joinery on the drawers and slow-close hinges are closer to high-end residential cabinetry than average RV cabinet construction.
- **Innovative Utility:** A standout feature is the built-in cutting board with a dedicated trash funnel—sweep scraps directly into the bin below without the mess.


## Built for the Elements (and Silence)


Forest River has engineered the Cedar Creek Cottage with 3” thick sidewalls and added insulation. Coupled with dual-pane glass windows, the[40CMK](https://forestriverinc.com/rvs/cedar-creek-cottage/40CMK/14886) excels at climate control and noise reduction, making it ideal for year-round living in select locations.


To keep things cool during summer months, the camper comes standard with three high-performance A/C units and a 52” ceiling fan. In colder months, 3M® bonded sidewalls with R11 insulation and 12V tank heating pads minimize heat transfer and protect against freezing temperatures. These are the qualities you’ll want from a semi-permanent camper.


## The Luxury Suite & Spa-Style Bath


Images by Forest River


Moving to the rear, the 40CMK features a private primary bedroom with a king bed in a slide-out. The space is optimized with a large wardrobe and a dedicated closet for a stackable washer and dryer. Of course, this second closet doubles as extra hanging storage if you choose not to install appliances.


The ensuite bathroom rivals many sticks-and-bricks homes, featuring:


- **Dual Vanities:** Solid surface countertops with double sinks for shared convenience.
- **Residential Shower:** A one-piece fiberglass shower with a “shower tower” multi-function sprayer and integrated seat.
- **Thoughtful Touches:** A dedicated vanity stool area for getting ready without the cramped feeling typical of RV baths.


## Key Specifications at a Glance


Image by Forest River


- **Length:** 41’6”
- **Hitch Weight:** 1,765 pounds
- **Dry Weight:** 12,519 pounds
- **Cargo Capacity:** 1,481 pounds
- **Sleeping Capacity:** Up to 4


Whether you are looking to retire on a lakefront lot or simply want a luxury escape, the Cedar Creek Cottage 40CMK proves that you can easily live smaller without compromising on space and comfort.


> *“This is something I could retire in,”* notes industry expert Ian Baker. *“With 3-inch walls and a kitchen this functional, it really feels like home.”*
